dataquality.why: Quality checks and matching are learned by running them on messy data; a threshold slider shows true and false matches directly.

spreadsheets.why: Excel skills stick by reading and writing real messy workbooks; automating one weekly report makes a natural small project.

webauto.why: You learn automation by scripting real pages; a decision flow keeps API first and legal checks before any clicking.

typescript.why: You learn a language by writing and running small programs; short explanations of types, async and validation make the drills make sense.
